questions.question: The length of a rectangular plot is 15 m more than its breadth. If the cost of fencing the plot at the rate of Rs. 16.50 per m is Rs. 4,950, then what is the length of the plot (in m)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of rectangular plot is 15 m more than its breadth.

Rate of cost of fencing is Rs.16.50 per m.

Total cost of fencing is Rs.4,950.

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(L + B)

**Calculation:**

Length of plot L = B + 15

Perimeter of plot = 2(L + B)

⇒ 2 {(B + 15 ) + B}

⇒ 2 (2B + 15)

⇒ 4B + 30

Now, the cost of fencing the plot at the rate of Rs.16.50 per m is Rs.4,950.

⇒ 16.50 × (4B + 30) = Rs.4,950

⇒ 66B + 495 = 4950

⇒ 66B = 4950 - 495

⇒ 66B = 4455

⇒ B = 4455/66 = 67.5

Length = B + 15 

⇒ 67.5 + 15 = 82.5 m

**∴ Length of the rectangular plot = 82.5 m**

questions.question: A man travelled the first part of his journey at 160 km/h and the second part at 240 km/h, and covered a total distance of 3840 km to his direction in 20 hours. How long, in hours, did the second part of his journey last?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of first part of journey = 160 km/h

Speed of second part of journey = 240 km/h

Total distance = 3840 km

Total time = 20 hr.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let time taken to travel in the first part = x hr.

Time taken to travel the second part = 20 - x hr.

Distance travelled in the first part = 160x

Distance travelled in the second part = 240(20 - x)

According to question:

Distance travelled in the first part = Distance travelled in the second part

⇒ 160x + 240(20 - x) = 3840

⇒ 160x + 4800 - 240x = 3840

⇒ - 80x = - 960

⇒ x = (-960)/(-80)

⇒ x = 12

Time taken in first half = x = 12 hr.

Time taken in second half = 20 - x = 20 - 12 = 8 hr.

**∴ Time taken in second half = 8 hr.**

questions.question: A vendor bought two varieties of tea, brand A and brand B, costing Rs. 15 per 100 g and Rs. 18 per 100 g, respectively, and mixed them in a certain ratio. For x g brand A will cost 15x/100

**∴ The ratio of the mixture of Brand A and B is 4 : 5**

questions.question: If A's income is 35% more than B's income, then by what percentage is B's income less than A's income (correct to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A's income is 35% more than B's income.

**Concept Used:**

Percentage = (A - B)/A × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the value of B be x.

Then, the value of A = (100 + 35)/100 × x = 1.35x

The percentage of B's income less than A's income = (1.35x - x)/1.35x × 100 = 25.92% ≈ 26%

**∴ The percentage of B's income less than A's income is 26%.**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 45 days. He works for 30 days and leaves. If B completes the remaining work in 5 days, then in how many days can B alone complete the entire work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 45 days.

A works for 30 days.

B completes the remaining work in 5 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work done = 1/Time

**Calculation:**

A can do a piece of work in 45 days.

A's 1 days work = 1/45

A's 30 days work = 1/45 × 30 = 2/3

The remaining work = 1 - 2/3 = 1/3

B's complete 1/3th of work in 5 days

Then, B's 1 day work = 1/(3 × 5) = 1/15

B can complete the whole work = 15 days 

**∴ B can complete the whole work is 15 days.**

questions.question: 2 years ago, the average age of a family of 5 members was 18 years. After a new member is added to the family, the average age of the family is still the same. The present age of the newly added member, in years, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of a family of 5 members 2 years ago was 18 years.

The average after a new member add to the family is 18 years.

**Concept Used:**

The average = Sum of the all numbers/Number of the numbers

**Calculation:**

The average age of a family of 5 members 2 years ago was 18 years.

The sum of age of all family member 2 years ago = 18 × 5 = 90 

The sum of age of all family member at present = 90 + 2 × 5 = 100

Let the age of new member be x.

The sum of age of a family of 6 member = 6 × 18 = 108

⇒ 100 + x = 108

⇒ x = 8 years

**∴ The age of new member of family is 8 years.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd67c9563cdde4a0dfe99b7686282bc07365f691adfb64c907de66aebe4b011.png] **

Let the age of new member be x.

The sum of age of a family of 6 member = 6 × 18 = 108

⇒ 18 × 5 + 2 × 5 + x = 108

⇒ 90 + 10 + x = 108

⇒ x = 8 years

∴ The age of new member of family is 8 years.

questions.question: An amount of Rs. 43,892 is lent to each of two persons for 3 years. One at the rate of 30% simple interest and the other at the rate of 30% compound interest, compounded annually. by what percentage will the simple interest be less than the compound interest received in this 3 - year duration (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The principal of each person is Rs.43892.

The first on SI at rate of 30% for 3 years.

The second on CI at rate of 30% for 3 years.

**Formula Used:**

SI = P × R × T/100

Amount = P[1 + R/100]ⁿ

CI = Amount - Principal

**Calculation:**

The principal of each person is Rs.43892.

The first on Simple Interest at rate of 30% for 3 years.

Simple Interest = 43892 × 30 × 3/100 = Rs.39502.8

The second on Compound Interest at rate of 30% for 3 years.

Amount = 43892[1 + 30/100]³

⇒ 43892 × 130/100 × 130/100 × 130/100

⇒ Rs.96430.72

Compound Interest = 96430.72 - 43892 ≈ Rs.52538

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest = Rs.13036

The percentage = 13036/52538 × 100 = 24.8%

**∴ The percentage simple interest be less than the compound interest is 24.8%. **

questions.question: The marked Price of an article is Rs. 5000. Three successive discounts of 15%, 10% and 18%, are given on its marked price. The selling price (in Rs.) of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked Price of an article is Rs. 5000.

Three successive discounts of 15%, 10% and 18%, are given on its marked price.

**Formula Used:**

Selling price = Marked price × (100 - Discount%)/100

**Calculation:**

The marked Price of an article is Rs. 5000.

The Selling Price = 5000 × (100 - 15)/100 × (100 - 10)/100 × (100 - 18)/100

⇒ 5000 × 85/100 × 90/100 × 82/100

⇒ Rs.3136.5

**∴ The Selling price of the article is Rs.3136.5.**
